neighbours.label: In code, the token right before a camelCase identifier that ends in 'Name' (config["|displayName, self.get|FirstName, = db|FileName, {resource|GroupName}): fires just ahead of a …Name identifier; the same code with other identifiers stays quiet

notes: Look: every top example sits one token before displayName, tableName, Hostname, FirstName, PropertyName, GroupName, FileName. Probes: config["firstName"] lines 0.77, self.getFirstName() 1.06, dbFileName 0.42; the same code with age/height/weight 0.006. The card shows this pole has almost as many activations above 0.3 of max as above 0.1 (a plateau), which a 16-sentence test cannot explain; coverage unknown.
